seo.title: Support - SSW EagleEye
seo.description: How to reach the EagleEye team, what response times to expect, where the docs and roadmap are, and the status of the 2 SSW-hosted endpoints your install depends on.

pageBlocks.byLine: EagleEye runs in your Azure subscription, so most questions are about install, permissions and tags. Here is how to reach us and what to expect.

pageBlocks.body:
## Contact us

| Need | Contact |
| --- | --- |
| Install, configuration, bugs, feature requests | [info@ssw.com.au](mailto:info@ssw.com.au?subject=EagleEye%20support) with "EagleEye" in the subject |
| Security vulnerability or security questionnaire | [security@ssw.com.au](mailto:security@ssw.com.au), see [Security](/security) |
| Phone, business hours | [+61 2 9953 3000](tel:+61299533000), 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM AEST, Monday to Friday |
| A demo or an evaluation call | [Book 30 minutes with the EagleEye team](https://outlook.office.com/bookwithme/user/97ccb01d46744eed9ad7ff2c52c3ade6@ssw.com.au/meetingtype/SVRwCe7HMUGxuT6WGxi68g2?anonymous&ep=mlink) |

When you email, include the EagleEye version from the Portal's About page, your Azure region, and whether the problem is in the Portal, a scheduled scan or a manual scan. Please do not paste email content or report data into a support request; a screenshot of the error and the job name is enough.

## Response targets

These are targets, not a service level agreement. During the public beta there are no service credits.

| Severity | Example | First response target |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Scans have stopped for everyone, or nobody can sign in to the Portal | 1 business day |
| 2 | A feature is broken for some users and there is a workaround | 2 business days |
| 3 | A question, a feature request, a cosmetic bug | 5 business days |

Business days are Monday to Friday, Sydney time, excluding New South Wales public holidays.

## Help yourself first

* [Documentation](/docs): install steps, permissions, tags, webhooks and Power BI.
* [App Registrations & Permissions](/docs/app-registrations-reference): why each Graph permission exists.
* [Manage Secrets for App Registrations](/docs/secret-management-app-registrations): rotating an expiring client secret.
* [Roadmap](/roadmap): what is done, in progress and coming.
* [Videos](https://www.youtube.com/@SSWEagleEye): install walkthroughs.
* Bug reports and feature requests: email us. SSW tracks each one and replies with the outcome.

## The 2 endpoints your install depends on

Everything else about EagleEye runs in your subscription. These 2 endpoints are hosted by SSW.

| Endpoint | Used | If it is down |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `https://api.ssweagleeye.com/api/acr/credentials` | During install and when you apply an update | New installs and updates fail. Running installations are not affected |
| `https://ssweagleeye.blob.core.windows.net/version-manifests/version.json` | When a signed-in user opens the Portal, and when someone checks for or starts an update | The Portal cannot offer or start updates. Scans, sign-in, reports and tags keep working |

Scans do not use the version manifest. Each release carries its own support end date, and scans pause when the installed release passes it.

There is no public status page yet. If a scan reports that scanning is disabled, the installed release has usually passed its support end date: apply the update from the Portal's About page. If the Portal cannot check for or start an update, open the version manifest URL above in a browser: if it loads, the problem is on your side of the network; if it does not load, email us and we will confirm and post an update here.

## Updates

The Portal checks the version manifest once a day and shows an *Update now* toast when a new release is available; you can also check for and start an update on the Portal's About page. Updates are applied by Azure in your subscription and take a few minutes. The installed version is shown on the Portal's About page.
